notes: Corrected: Seemeth it moved off the interrogative particle. Rule 17 gives הַ a fronted auxiliary (Shall, do) and expressly leaves the particle unrepresented where the question is marked by inversion alone with no auxiliary written; Seemeth is an inverted linking verb, so the particle takes nothing and the copula with its dummy subject joins the predicate מְעַט, on rule 20's it was precedent. The competing reading is recorded in both affected units.
The unit for מְעַט now reads Seemeth it a small thing, headed on small by rule 31's subtraction test.

Unchanged elsewhere: the phrase's one the goes to the first article of המרעה הטוב with the agreement article unrepresented (rule 47), and the supplied upon and of reach bare Hebrew objects and so stay with their verbs (rule 44).
